verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is documented as API-driven. Cards and cardholders are created via API endpoints, and the docs state that disputes and funding details are available through both the Dashboard and the API. Stripe staff on HN also describe Issuing as 'an API-first product'. However, no evidence explicitly claims full Dashboard/API parity, and several features (physical card design customization, digital wallet setup) are not shown to be API-accessible. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of complete UI/API parity, API evidence for card design and digital-wallet management, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Stripe offers a guided Dashboard process and an API to submit disputes and monitor them through to resolution.
Using the Stripe Dashboard or API, you can access the bank account and routing information you need to push funds from your external bank account.
Stripe Issuing is an API-first product
Use the Stripe Issuing API to create, manage, and distribute payment cards for your business.
